overall.assessment: Podcast sadržajno i duhovno snažno promiče kulturu života, utemeljenu na nepovredivom dostojanstvu svake ljudske osobe od začeća do prirodne smrti. Kroz svjedočanstva i molitvene inicijative, projekt uspješno povezuje teološku istinu o svetosti života s konkretnim pastoralnim djelovanjem i brigom za najranjivije. Ovakav pristup izravno odgovara na poziv Crkve za stvaranjem 'kulture života i ljubavi' koja se suprotstavlja 'kulturi smrti'.
seeds_of_logos: Povezivanje molitve i posta kao duhovnog oružja (Evangelium Vitae 100)
Pastoralna skrb za trudnice i konkretna pomoć
Javno svjedočenje vjere u javnom prostoru
overall.theological_context: Katolički nauk o životu temelji se na uvjerenju da je svaka osoba stvorena na sliku Božju (KKC 2319). Enciklika 'Evangelium Vitae' sv. Ivana Pavla II. ključni je dokument koji poziva na izgradnju kulture života, dok 'Amoris Laetitia' pape Franje naglašava ljepotu i misterij začeća kao sudjelovanje u Božjem stvaranju.

sections.subtitle: Alen Hržica: Plemenita priča i duhovna podrška
sections.screenshot_description: Alen Hržica s mikrofonom na pozornici, izražava zahvalnost i zadovoljstvo sudjelovanjem.
sections.content: Glazbenik **Alen Hržica** izrazio je svoju duboku zahvalnost i radost što je bio dio humanitarnog koncerta 'Hrvatska za život'. Istaknuo je kako je sudjelovanje u ovakvoj plemenitoj priči, koja uključuje pomaganje i spašavanje života, nešto najhumanije što čovjek može učiniti. Večer je opisao kao predivno i ugodno druženje s publikom, koje je ujedno i doprinijelo plemenitom cilju. Hržica je čestitao organizatorima na njihovom radu, potičući ih da nastave istim putem, te je obećao svoju podršku, kako u molitvi tako i kroz buduće sudjelovanje na poziv.

magisterium.assessment: Sadržaj je u potpunosti usklađen s katoličkim naukom o svetosti života i važnosti zalaganja za najranjivije.
magisterium.enrichment: Katolička crkva uči da je svaki ljudski život svet od začeća do prirodne smrti, što je temelj kršćanske ljubavi prema bližnjemu (CCC 2319). Sudjelovanje u aktivnostima koje promiču život izraz je kršćanske solidarnosti i ljubavi.
magisterium.assessment_en: The content is fully aligned with Catholic teaching on the holiness of life and the importance of advocating for the most vulnerable.
magisterium.enrichment_en: The Catholic Church teaches that every human life is sacred from conception to natural death, which is the foundation of Christian love for one's neighbor (CCC 2319). Participating in activities that promote life is an expression of Christian solidarity and love.

sections.subtitle_en: Alen Hržica: A Noble Story and Spiritual Support
sections.screenshot_description_en: Alen Hržica with a microphone on the stage, expressing gratitude and satisfaction with participating.
sections.content_en: Musician **Alen Hržica** expressed his deep gratitude and joy for being part of the humanitarian concert 'Hrvatska za život'. He pointed out that participating in such a noble story, which includes helping and saving lives, is something the most humane a person can do. He described the evening as a beautiful and pleasant gathering with the audience, which also contributed to the noble goal. Hržica congratulated the organizers on their work, encouraging them to continue on the same path, and promised his support, both in prayer and through future participation upon invitation.

sections.subtitle: Misija Udruge 'Hrvatska za život': Dostojanstvo od začeća do prirodne smrti
sections.screenshot_description: Klaudija Popović objašnjava misiju udruge 'Hrvatska za život'.
sections.content: Predstavnica udruge 'Hrvatska za život', **Klaudija Popović**, naglasila je kako se na koncertu okupio velik broj ljudi koji žele podržati život. Udruga 'Hrvatska za život' posvećena je brizi da se svaki začeti život rodi te da se osigura poštovanje dostojanstva čovjeka od samog začeća do prirodne smrti. Koncert je bio prilika za okupljanje i jačanje podrške ovoj važnoj misiji.

magisterium.assessment: Odlomak vjerno prenosi crkveni nauk o dostojanstvu ljudske osobe od začeća do prirodne smrti.
magisterium.enrichment: Crkva dosljedno brani pravo na život kao temeljno ljudsko pravo, naglašavajući da se ljudsko dostojanstvo ne smije umanjivati ni u jednoj fazi razvoja (Evangelium Vitae 60; Donum Vitae 79). Zaštita života je primarni kriterij u vrednovanju javnih politika.
magisterium.assessment_en: The passage faithfully conveys the Church's teaching on the dignity of the human person from conception to natural death.
magisterium.enrichment_en: The Church consistently defends the right to life as a fundamental human right, emphasizing that human dignity must not be diminished at any stage of development (Evangelium Vitae 60; Donum Vitae 79). The protection of life is the primary criterion in the evaluation of public policies.

sections.subtitle_en: The Mission of the Association 'Croatia for Life': Dignity from Conception to Natural Death
sections.screenshot_description_en: Klaudija Popović explains the mission of the association 'Hrvatska za život'.
sections.content_en: The representative of the association 'Hrvatska za život', **Klaudija Popović**, emphasized that a large number of people who want to support life gathered at the concert. The association 'Hrvatska za život' is dedicated to caring that every conceived life is born and to ensuring respect for human dignity from conception to natural death. The concert was an opportunity for gathering and strengthening support for this important mission.

sections.subtitle: Tiho Orlić: Širenje ProLife svijesti unutar benda Marka Perkovića Thompsona
sections.screenshot_description: Tiho Orlić govori o utjecaju ProLife pokreta na članove benda.
sections.content: **Tiho Orlić**, član benda Marka Perkovića Thompsona, izrazio je zadovoljstvo što je s **Markom Perkovićem Thompsonom** i cijelim bendom sudjelovao na koncertu. Istaknuo je kako je Marko tražio da cijeli bend bude prisutan, što je dovelo do zanimljivih razgovora unutar benda o radu udruge 'Hrvatska za život' i širem ProLife pokretu u Hrvatskoj. Orlić je bio sretan što je mogao posvjedočiti o važnosti ove misije i zapaliti za nju i one članove benda koji možda nisu bili u potpunosti upoznati s opsegom i djelovanjem pokreta. Smatra da je to uloga kršćana – utjecati na svoju mikro sredinu.

magisterium.assessment: Odlomak odražava pozitivnu inicijativu unutar profesionalnog okruženja, potičući dijalog o vrijednostima života.
magisterium.enrichment: Kršćani su pozvani svjedočiti evanđelje u svim sferama života, uključujući radno mjesto, promičući kulturu života nasuprot 'kulturi odbacivanja' (Evangelii Gaudium 53). Dijalog unutar zajednica o ovim temama pomaže u širenju svijesti o svetosti života.
magisterium.assessment_en: The passage reflects a positive initiative within a professional environment, encouraging dialogue about the values of life.
magisterium.enrichment_en: Christians are called to witness the Gospel in all spheres of life, including the workplace, promoting a culture of life as opposed to the 'throwaway culture' (Evangelii Gaudium 53). Dialogue within communities on these topics helps in spreading awareness of the sanctity of life.

sections.subtitle_en: Tiho Orlić: Spreading ProLife awareness within the band of Marko Perković Thompson
sections.screenshot_description_en: Tiho Orlić speaks about the influence of the ProLife movement on the band members.
sections.content_en: **Tiho Orlić**, a member of Marko Perković Thompson's band, expressed his satisfaction that he participated in the concert with **Marko Perković Thompson** and the entire band. He pointed out that Marko requested the entire band to be present, which led to interesting conversations within the band about the work of the association 'Hrvatska za život' and the wider ProLife movement in Croatia. Orlić was happy to be able to witness to the importance of this mission and to ignite for it also those band members who perhaps were not fully familiar with the scope and activity of the movement. He believes that this is the role of Christians – to influence their micro-environment.

sections.subtitle: Majka Mihaela: Osobno svjedočanstvo o pomoći i duhovnoj obnovi
sections.screenshot_description: Majka Mihaela emotivno svjedoči o pomoći udruge i duhovnom iskustvu.
sections.content: Jedna od majki, **Majka Mihaela**, podijelila je svoje dirljivo svjedočanstvo, zahvalivši udruzi 'Hrvatska za život' na pomoći koju su pružili njoj i njezinom sinu Mihaelu. Istaknula je kako su uz podršku udruge, pozitivnog stava i vjere u Boga uspjeli prebroditi poteškoće. Koncert je opisala kao nevjerojatnu duhovnu obnovu, osjećajući se kao dio velike obitelji, te je poželjela da svaka majka doživi takvo iskustvo.

magisterium.assessment: Svjedočanstvo naglašava važnost duhovne i materijalne podrške obiteljima, što je u skladu s kršćanskom ljubavlju.
magisterium.enrichment: Crkva potiče konkretnu pomoć obiteljima i majkama u potrebi, prepoznajući obitelj kao temeljnu jedinicu društva (Compendium of the Social Doctrine of the Church 185). Duhovna obnova i vjera u Boga ključni su oslonci u prevladavanju životnih poteškoća.
magisterium.assessment_en: The testimony emphasizes the importance of spiritual and material support to families, which is in accordance with Christian love.
magisterium.enrichment_en: The Church encourages concrete help to families and mothers in need, recognizing the family as the fundamental unit of society (Compendium of the Social Doctrine of the Church 185). Spiritual renewal and faith in God are key supports in overcoming life's difficulties.

sections.subtitle_en: Mother Mihaela: Personal testimony about help and spiritual renewal
sections.screenshot_description_en: Mother Mihaela emotionally testifies about the help of the association and the spiritual experience.
sections.content_en: One of the mothers, **Majka Mihaela**, shared her touching testimony, thanking the association 'Hrvatska za život' for the help they provided to her and her son Mihael. She pointed out that with the support of the association, a positive attitude, and faith in God, they managed to overcome the difficulties. She described the concert as an incredible spiritual renewal, feeling like a part of a big family, and wished that every mother would experience such an experience.

sections.subtitle: Marija Husar Rimac: Izvedba himne 'Psalam 139' kao zahvala Stvoritelju
sections.screenshot_description: Marija Husar Rimac pjeva ili govori o himni 'Psalam 139'.
sections.content: Pjevačica **Marija Husar Rimac** izrazila je veliku čast što je mogla biti dio humanitarnog koncerta i izvesti himnu inicijative 'Psalam 139'. Objasnila je da pjesma, nazvana 'Hvala ti', predstavlja zahvalu Gospodinu što smo svi čudesno stvoreni, naglašavajući duboku duhovnu poruku o vrijednosti svakog života.

magisterium.assessment: Sadržaj je u potpunosti usklađen s katoličkim naukom o svetosti života i biblijskom inspiracijom.
magisterium.enrichment: Psalam 139 slavi Boga kao Stvoritelja koji nas poznaje i oblikuje u majčinoj utrobi, što je temelj kršćanskog poštovanja prema životu od začeća. Crkveni nauk, posebno u 'Evangelium Vitae', naglašava da je ljudski život dar Božji i svetinja.
magisterium.assessment_en: The content is fully aligned with the Catholic teaching on the sanctity of life and biblical inspiration.
magisterium.enrichment_en: Psalm 139 praises God as the Creator who knows us and forms us in our mother's womb, which is the foundation of Christian respect for life from conception. Church teaching, especially in 'Evangelium Vitae', emphasizes that human life is a gift of God and sacred.

sections.subtitle_en: Marija Husar Rimac: Performance of the hymn 'Psalm 139' as thanksgiving to the Creator
sections.screenshot_description_en: Marija Husar Rimac sings or speaks about the hymn 'Psalm 139'.
sections.content_en: Singer **Marija Husar Rimac** expressed a great honor to have been able to be part of the humanitarian concert and perform the anthem of the initiative 'Psalam 139'. She explained that the song, named 'Hvala ti', represents thanksgiving to the Lord that we are all wonderfully made, emphasizing a deep spiritual message about the value of every life.

sections.subtitle: Kruna predanog rada: Rast kulture života u Hrvatskoj
sections.screenshot_description: Široki kadar publike na koncertu, simbolizirajući rast svijesti o životu.
sections.content: Jedna od **podržavateljica Udruge** izrazila je zadovoljstvo što je udruga 'Hrvatska za život' napokon dočekala svoj prvi humanitarni koncert, videći ga kao krunu predanog i požrtvovnog rada svih volontera i štićenika. Istaknula je da je kroz godine bilo mnogo blagoslova te da svijest o važnosti života i 'kultura života' sve više raste u Hrvatskoj. Veliki odaziv na koncert jasan je pokazatelj te rastuće osviještenosti.

magisterium.assessment: Promicanje 'kulture života' izravno je u skladu s crkvenim naukom i pozivom na evangelizaciju.
magisterium.enrichment: Papa Ivan Pavao II. u 'Evangelium Vitae' poziva na izgradnju 'kulture života' kao odgovor na 'kulturu smrti', naglašavajući odgovornost vjernika da svjedoče za život u društvu.
magisterium.assessment_en: Promoting the 'culture of life' is directly in alignment with Church teaching and the call to evangelization.
magisterium.enrichment_en: Pope John Paul II in 'Evangelium Vitae' calls for the building of a 'culture of life' as a response to the 'culture of death', emphasizing the responsibility of believers to witness for life in society.

sections.subtitle_en: The crown of dedicated work: The growth of the culture of life in Croatia
sections.screenshot_description_en: A wide shot of the audience at the concert, symbolizing the growth of awareness about life.
sections.content_en: One of the **supporters of the Association** expressed her satisfaction that the association 'Hrvatska za život' has finally welcomed its first humanitarian concert, seeing it as the crown of the dedicated and sacrificial work of all volunteers and protégés. She pointed out that through the years there have been many blessings and that awareness of the importance of life and the 'culture of life' is growing more and more in Croatia. The large turnout for the concert is a clear indicator of that growing awareness.

sections.subtitle: Ivana Husar Mlinac: Javno svjedočenje i razbijanje tabua
sections.screenshot_description: Ivana Husar Mlinac govori o važnosti javne podrške i otvorenog razgovora.
sections.content: **Ivana Husar Mlinac** naglasila je važnost javnog svjedočenja i podrške, ističući da 'nijedan koncert nije previše, nijedan grad nije previše'. Pozvala je ljude da potiču jedni druge na razgovor o životu, kako tema ne bi ostala tabu i kako se važne stvari ne bi događale iza zatvorenih vrata. Smatra da je javno pridruživanje ovakvim inicijativama, posebno kroz pjesmu, najmanje što se može učiniti, ali s punim srcem.

magisterium.assessment: Poziv na javno svjedočenje i otvoreni dijalog o životu u skladu je s misijom Crkve.
magisterium.enrichment: Javno svjedočenje vjere i kršćanskih vrijednosti, uključujući svetost života, ključno je za evangelizaciju društva. Crkva potiče vjernike da budu 'sol zemlje i svjetlo svijeta' kroz hrabro svjedočenje istine.
magisterium.assessment_en: A call to public witnessing and open dialogue about life is in accordance with the mission of the Church.
magisterium.enrichment_en: Public witnessing of faith and Christian values, including the sanctity of life, is key to the evangelization of society. The Church encourages believers to be 'salt of the earth and light of the world' through courageous witnessing of the truth.

sections.subtitle_en: Ivana Husar Mlinac: Public testimony and breaking taboos
sections.screenshot_description_en: Ivana Husar Mlinac speaks about the importance of public support and open conversation.
sections.content_en: **Ivana Husar Mlinac** emphasized the importance of public witnessing and support, pointing out that 'no concert is too much, no city is too much'. She called on people to encourage one another to talk about life, so that the topic would not remain a taboo and so that important things would not happen behind closed doors. She believes that publicly joining such initiatives, especially through song, is the least that can be done, but with a full heart.

sections.subtitle: Snaga zajedničke molitve i vrijednost svakog života
sections.screenshot_description: Publika u molitvi ili slušanju, naglašavajući zajedništvo.
sections.content: **Klaudija Popović** je ponovno istaknula temeljno uvjerenje da je svaki život jednako vrijedan od začeća nadalje. **Duhovnik** je nadopunio tu misao naglašavajući veliku važnost okupljanja gdje je u središtu Gospodin, jer takva okupljanja omogućuju ljudima da slave istinu. Posebno je istaknuo snagu zajedničke molitve, citirajući Isusove riječi da je prisutan tamo gdje su dvojica ili trojica okupljena u Njegovo ime. Također, Duhovnik je izrazio nadu da će ovakvi događaji pružiti priliku mladim parovima da se upoznaju i postanu budući roditelji, kroz koje će Bog darovati život.

magisterium.assessment: Naglasak na vrijednosti svakog života i snazi zajedničke molitve potpuno je utemeljen u Svetom pismu i tradiciji.
magisterium.enrichment: Isusovo obećanje o prisutnosti ondje gdje su dvojica ili trojica okupljena u Njegovo ime (Mt 18,20) temelj je kršćanske zajedničke molitve. Crkva uči da je svaki život svet od začeća do prirodne smrti.
magisterium.assessment_en: The emphasis on the value of every life and the power of common prayer is completely grounded in Holy Scripture and tradition.
magisterium.enrichment_en: Jesus' promise of presence where two or three are gathered in His name (Mt 18:20) is the foundation of Christian communal prayer. The Church teaches that every life is sacred from conception to natural death.

sections.subtitle_en: The power of common prayer and the value of every life
sections.screenshot_description_en: The audience in prayer or listening, emphasizing communion.
sections.content_en: **Klaudija Popović** once again emphasized the fundamental belief that every life is equally valuable from conception onward. The **spiritual director** complemented this thought by emphasizing the great importance of gathering where the Lord is at the center, because such gatherings enable people to celebrate the truth. He especially emphasized the power of common prayer, quoting Jesus' words that He is present where two or three are gathered in His name. Also, the spiritual director expressed hope that events like this will provide an opportunity for young couples to meet and become future parents, through whom God will grant life.

sections.subtitle: Opća Opasnost: Doprinos promjeni kulture života u Hrvatskoj
sections.screenshot_description: Član benda Opća Opasnost na pozornici, s publikom u pozadini.
sections.content: **Član benda Opća Opasnost** izrazio je veliku sreću i čast što su pozvani da pjevaju na humanitarnom koncertu, ističući da time doprinose promjeni kulture života i življenja u Hrvatskoj. Nakon mnogo godina, bilo im je lijepo ponovno stati na pozornicu. Pohvalio je sve ljude koji se bore za svaki život, naglašavajući važnost njihove misije. **Aktivistica** je dodala da ova inicijativa nije samo za žene ili muškarce, već za cijelo čovječanstvo, jer smo svi potekli od žene.

magisterium.assessment: Sadržaj je u potpunosti usklađen s katoličkim naukom o promicanju kulture života i odgovornosti vjernika u društvu.
magisterium.enrichment: Katolički nauk naglašava da je svaki ljudski život svet od začeća do prirodne smrti. Vjernici su pozvani stvarati i podržavati institucije koje poboljšavaju uvjete ljudskog života, djelujući kao 'kvasac' u svijetu.

citations.document_title: Lay Catholics in Schools: Witnesses to Faith
citations.document_author: The Sacred Congregation for Catholic Education

magisterium.assessment_en: The content is fully aligned with Catholic teaching on promoting the culture of life and the responsibility of believers in society.
magisterium.enrichment_en: Catholic teaching emphasizes that every human life is sacred from conception to natural death. Believers are called to create and support institutions that improve the conditions of human life, acting as 'leaven' in the world.

sections.subtitle_en: Opća Opasnost: Contribution to changing the culture of life in Croatia
sections.screenshot_description_en: A member of the band Opća Opasnost on stage, with the audience in the background.
sections.content_en: **A member of the band Opća Opasnost** expressed great happiness and honor that they were invited to sing at the humanitarian concert, emphasizing that by doing so they contribute to changing the culture of life and living in Hrvatska. After many years, it was beautiful for them to stand on the stage again. He praised all the people who fight for every life, emphasizing the importance of their mission. **An activist** added that this initiative is not only for women or men, but for all of humanity, because we all came from a woman.

sections.subtitle: Svećenikov blagoslov i nada u spašavanje života
sections.screenshot_description: Svećenik blagoslivlja okupljene i udrugu 'Hrvatska za život'.
sections.content: **Svećenik** je uputio blagoslov udruzi 'Hrvatska za život' za sva njihova djela i potporu majkama i djeci za koje se bore. Izrazio je radost zbog velikog broja okupljenih ljudi u ispunjenoj dvorani, koji su zajedno slavili Boga. Izrazio je nadu i vjeru da će koncertom uspjeti postići barem dio potrebnih sredstava i podrške kako bi udruga mogla nastaviti s velikim djelima spašavanja ljudskih života. Zaključio je porukom 'Bog vas blagoslovi'.

magisterium.assessment: Sadržaj je u potpunosti usklađen s katoličkim naukom o važnosti molitve, blagoslova i podrške obiteljima i životu.
magisterium.enrichment: Crkva potiče vjernike da budu 'narod života i za život', pružajući konkretnu podršku obiteljima kao 'svetištima života'. Svećenički blagoslov i zajedničko slavljenje Boga jačaju zajedništvo i poslanje vjernika u svijetu.
magisterium.assessment_en: The content is fully aligned with Catholic teaching on the importance of prayer, blessing, and support for families and life.
magisterium.enrichment_en: The Church encourages the faithful to be a 'people of life and for life', providing concrete support to families as 'sanctuaries of life'. The priestly blessing and the communal celebration of God strengthen the communion and mission of the faithful in the world.

sections.subtitle_en: The priest's blessing and hope in saving a life
sections.screenshot_description_en: The priest blesses the gathered people and the association 'Hrvatska za život'.
sections.content_en: **The priest** sent a blessing to the association 'Hrvatska za život' for all their deeds and support to mothers and children for whom they fight. He expressed joy because of the large number of gathered people in the filled hall, who celebrated God together. He expressed hope and faith that with the concert they would succeed in achieving at least a part of the necessary funds and support so that the association could continue with the great deeds of saving human lives. He concluded with the message 'God bless you'.

sections.subtitle: Klaudija Popović: Javno svjedočenje vjere i glas za nerođene
sections.screenshot_description: Klaudija Popović strastveno govori o javnom svjedočenju vjere.
sections.content: **Klaudija Popović** istaknula je važnost javnog svjedočenja vjere, podsjećajući da je Isus umro javno, a ne tajno, stoga ni vjera ne smije biti tajna. Naglasila je da njezina vjera snažno utječe na njezina djela i da se ne smije šutjeti, već treba dići glas za one koji to ne mogu – nerođene. Svrha okupljanja je zahvaliti, podržati i slaviti život, te slijediti Isusa, koji je put, istina i život. Također je naglasila važnost pružanja podrške majkama u najtežim trenucima, molitvom, riječima i djelima, kako bi sačuvale najvrjedniji dar – život.

magisterium.assessment: Sadržaj je u potpunosti usklađen s katoličkim naukom o javnom svjedočenju vjere i zaštiti najslabijih.
magisterium.enrichment: Vjernici su pozvani ne skrivati nadu, već javno svjedočiti vjeru kroz djela ljubavi i pravde, posebno braneći one koji su slabi i nezaštićeni. Javno svjedočenje vjere, poput Kristovog, ključno je za preobrazbu društva i borbu protiv 'kulture smrti'.
magisterium.assessment_en: The content is fully aligned with Catholic teaching on the public witnessing of faith and the protection of the weakest.
magisterium.enrichment_en: Believers are called not to hide hope, but to publicly witness the faith through works of love and justice, especially defending those who are weak and unprotected. Public witnessing of the faith, like Christ's, is crucial for the transformation of society and the fight against the 'culture of death'.

sections.subtitle_en: Klaudija Popović: Public witnessing of faith and a voice for the unborn
sections.screenshot_description_en: Klaudija Popović passionately speaks about the public witnessing of faith.
sections.content_en: **Klaudija Popović** emphasized the importance of publicly witnessing the faith, recalling that Jesus died publicly, and not in secret, therefore faith also must not be a secret. She emphasized that her faith strongly influences her actions and that one must not remain silent, but rather raise one's voice for those who cannot do so – the unborn. The purpose of the gathering is to thank, support, and celebrate life, and to follow Jesus, who is the way, the truth, and the life. She also emphasized the importance of providing support to mothers in the most difficult moments, through prayer, words, and deeds, so that they would preserve the most valuable gift – life.

sections.subtitle: Pozitivni dojmovi publike i angažman mladih uz Thompsona
sections.screenshot_description: Mladi ljudi u publici, sretni i angažirani na koncertu.
sections.content: **Posjetiteljica 1** opisala je večer kao predivnu, ispunjenu pjevanjem i veseljem u duhu vjere. **Posjetiteljica 2** izrazila je iznimnu sreću što je prisustvovala koncertu s prijateljima, ističući da je nastup **Marka Perkovića Thompsona** dodatno uljepšao iskustvo. Posebno ju je obradovao velik broj mladih ljudi, za koje ima prekrasne osjećaje, prepoznajući da im je danas teže nego prijašnjim generacijama.

magisterium.assessment: Sadržaj je usklađen s katoličkim naukom o važnosti mladih i njihovom angažmanu u vjeri.
magisterium.enrichment: Crkva prepoznaje mlade kao 'stvarnu mladost svijeta' i poziva ih da u Isusu, koji je dijelio njihovu mladost, pronađu snagu i nadu. Angažman mladih u duhu vjere doprinosi obnovi Crkve i društva.
magisterium.assessment_en: The content is aligned with Catholic teaching on the importance of youth and their engagement in the faith.
magisterium.enrichment_en: The Church recognizes young people as the 'real youth of the world' and invites them to find strength and hope in Jesus, who shared their youth. The engagement of young people in the spirit of faith contributes to the renewal of the Church and society.

sections.subtitle_en: Positive impressions of the audience and the engagement of the youth with Thompson
sections.screenshot_description_en: Young people in the audience, happy and engaged at the concert.
sections.content_en: **Female Visitor 1** described the evening as beautiful, filled with singing and joy in the spirit of faith. **Female Visitor 2** expressed exceptional happiness to have attended the concert with friends, emphasizing that the performance of **Marko Perković Thompson** additionally embellished the experience. She was especially pleased by the large number of young people, for whom she has beautiful feelings, recognizing that it is harder for them today than for previous generations.

sections.subtitle: Koncert kao duhovna priprema i dugogodišnje sudjelovanje u '40 dana za život'
sections.screenshot_description: Dugogodišnji volonter govori o svom iskustvu i povezanosti s '40 dana za život'.
sections.content: **Dugogodišnji volonter** izjavio je da mu je ovo prvi put na ovakvom koncertu, ali ga je doživio kao najljepšu pripremu za blagdan Duhova, osjećajući da su Duhovi već te večeri. Spomenuo je svoje dugogodišnje sudjelovanje u inicijativi '40 dana za život' od samih početaka, ispred Vinogradske bolnice, s Antom, Petrom i Dianom. **Obožavatelj Thompsona** izrazio je svoje oduševljenje koncertom, priznavši da je promukao od pjevanja i uživanja u duhovnoj glazbi, posebno ističući **Marka Perkovića Thompsona** kao svog najdražeg pjevača.

magisterium.assessment: Sadržaj je u potpunosti usklađen s katoličkim naukom, povezujući duhovnu radost s konkretnim zalaganjem za život.
magisterium.enrichment: Kršćanska radost često proizlazi iz služenja životu, što je temelj 'Evanđelja života'. Duhovi su blagdan koji označava puninu Duha Svetoga, a povezivanje tog blagdana s molitvenim i aktivnim zalaganjem za nerođene odražava kršćansku praksu kontemplativnog djelovanja.
magisterium.assessment_en: The content is fully aligned with Catholic teaching, connecting spiritual joy with a concrete commitment to life.
magisterium.enrichment_en: Christian joy often arises from serving life, which is the foundation of the 'Gospel of Life'. Pentecost is a feast that marks the fullness of the Holy Spirit, and connecting that feast with prayerful and active commitment for the unborn reflects the Christian practice of contemplative action.

sections.subtitle_en: The concert as a spiritual preparation and long-term participation in '40 dana za život'
sections.screenshot_description_en: A long-time volunteer speaks about his experience and connection with '40 dana za život'.
sections.content_en: **A long-time volunteer** stated that this was his first time at this kind of concert, but he experienced it as the most beautiful preparation for the feast of Pentecost, feeling that Pentecost was already that evening. He mentioned his long-time participation in the '40 dana za život' initiative from the very beginning, in front of the Vinogradska hospital, with Ante, Petar, and Diana. **A fan of Thompson** expressed his enthusiasm for the concert, admitting that he was hoarse from singing and enjoying spiritual music, especially highlighting **Marko Perković Thompson** as his favorite singer.

sections.subtitle: Duhovni utjecaj koncerta i poziv na izbor života
sections.screenshot_description: Duhovni voditelj govori o prisutnosti Duha Svetoga i nadi u spašavanje života.
sections.content: **Duhovni voditelj** opisao je osjećaj punine u srcu i snage Duha Svetoga koja je ispunila dvoranu, vjerujući da je dvorana blagoslovljena. Izrazio je nadu da će se djeca spašavati i da će netko od prisutnih odgovoriti nekoga od pobačaja. **Klaudija Popović** izrazila je izuzetno zadovoljstvo, vjerujući da je koncert donio veliku radost mnogima, potaknuo srca na slavljenje Gospodina i da će supružnici nakon ove večeri odlučiti za više života, naglašavajući da se 'Hrvatska voli djecom'.

magisterium.assessment: Sadržaj snažno promiče katoličke vrijednosti, naglašavajući važnost molitve i djelovanja za zaštitu nerođenog života.
magisterium.enrichment: Crkva uči da je zaštita života od začeća sveta dužnost, a molitva za one koji su u iskušenju pobačaja izraz je kršćanske ljubavi i solidarnosti. Duh Sveti, kao izvor snage, vodi vjernike u evangelizaciji i obrani dostojanstva svake osobe.
magisterium.assessment_en: The content strongly promotes Catholic values, emphasizing the importance of prayer and action for the protection of unborn life.
magisterium.enrichment_en: The Church teaches that the protection of life from conception is a holy duty, and prayer for those who are in the temptation of abortion is an expression of Christian love and solidarity. The Holy Spirit, as the source of strength, leads believers in evangelization and the defense of the dignity of every person.

sections.subtitle_en: The spiritual impact of the concert and the call to choose life
sections.screenshot_description_en: The spiritual director speaks about the presence of the Holy Spirit and the hope of saving lives.
sections.content_en: **The spiritual director** described the feeling of fullness in the heart and the power of the Holy Spirit that filled the hall, believing that the hall was blessed. He expressed hope that children will be saved and that someone from those present will talk someone out of an abortion. **Klaudija Popović** expressed exceptional satisfaction, believing that the concert brought great joy to many, prompted hearts to praise the Lord, and that spouses will decide for more life after this evening, emphasizing that 'Croatia is loved with children'.

sections.subtitle: Završna poruka zadovoljstva i nade u ponovni susret
sections.screenshot_description: Sudionik izražava zadovoljstvo i pozdravlja, s osmijehom na licu.
sections.content: Jedan od **sudionika** koncerta izrazio je opće zadovoljstvo i sreću zbog uspješno održanog događaja. Kratkom, ali srdačnom porukom, izrazio je nadu u ponovni susret, što sugerira uspjeh i želju za nastavkom ovakvih plemenitih inicijativa.

magisterium.assessment: Sadržaj je usklađen s katoličkim naukom, izražavajući zajedništvo i nadu u nastavak plemenitih inicijativa.
magisterium.enrichment: Zajedništvo vjernika u promicanju dobra i kulture života odražava poziv na izgradnju civilizacije ljubavi. Podrška ovakvim inicijativama potiče vjernike na ustrajnost u svjedočenju vjere u svakodnevnom životu.
magisterium.assessment_en: The content is aligned with Catholic teaching, expressing communion and hope in the continuation of noble initiatives.
magisterium.enrichment_en: The communion of believers in promoting the good and the culture of life reflects the call to build a civilization of love. Support for such initiatives encourages believers to persevere in witnessing the faith in everyday life.

sections.subtitle_en: Final message of satisfaction and hope for a new meeting
sections.screenshot_description_en: The participant expresses satisfaction and greets, with a smile on their face.
sections.content_en: One of the **participants** of the concert expressed general satisfaction and happiness because of the successfully held event. With a short but cordial message, he expressed hope for a new meeting, which suggests success and a desire for the continuation of such noble initiatives.

iterations.theme_en: Testimonials and impact of the humanitarian concert 'Hrvatska za život'
